title: E0079: Dynamic method call
plain_english: Invoking a method using a method name that comes from user input can allow an attacker to call unintended methods on your objects.
why_matters: Dynamic method invocation can: - Reach unintended business logic or internal methods - Bypass access controls on sensitive operations - Execute dangerous methods with attacker-controlled arguments
what_it_checks: `$obj->$method()` where `$method` is a variable from user input
